answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, held in escrow until finality, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vertex of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The nebula lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the sonnet is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
